role: 若葉の印 (head; id head_leaf_crown). A young-leaf mark on the forehead: an arrowhead notched on top and split down the middle, yellow on the left and green on the right, set over the red gem (the gem peeks through the notch).
note: Centered on the forehead gem (about +5.5, +8.3 from the head anchor, measured for the ice crystal). Alpha is 0/255 only.
history: First 若葉の冠: the front half of a thin ring of leaves worn low on the helmet (generate-image-v2 seed 8204 #37, 24x8; earlier bitforge and full-crown tries were dropped). The user found it looked just like a crown of thorns and asked for a one-point mark on the forehead instead, like the ice crystal. Of three hand-drawn ideas (two sprout leaves, a beginner-mark style arrowhead, one leaf) the user picked the mark, a little bigger (7x7 → 9x9), and renamed it 若葉の印. The id stays head_leaf_crown so saves that own it keep it.
